# graviteeam_group_members (Resource)

Manages the set of members belonging to a Gravitee AM group. Terraform manages the complete membership list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_group_members" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  group_id  = graviteeam_group.example.id
  members   = [graviteeam_user.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group
- `members` (Set of String) Set of user IDs that are members of the group
